Because the whisper lockup is enforced by the prism escrow, the saffron audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. The bond is locked for 8 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
